metaDescription: CPT 98975 explained: the one-time Remote Therapeutic Monitoring setup and patient education code. Requirements, billing limits, 2026 rate and mistakes.
summary: The one-time RTM code for setting up the monitoring tool and teaching the patient how to use it for therapy, respiratory or pain tracking.
time: Setup and education, no monthly minute threshold
performer: The billing practitioner or therapist, or staff under general supervision where incident-to billing applies
frequency: Typically once per episode of care; confirm with your MAC
requirements: An order or plan from the billing practitioner for remote therapeutic monitoring
A device or software that meets the FDA definition of a medical device
For therapist-billed RTM, a therapy plan of care and the GP, GO or GN modifier
A record that setup was done and the patient was taught to use the tool
pitfalls: Billing setup again for a patient already inside an episode of care
Using an app that does not meet the device definition

faqs.question: Can 98975 be billed every month?
faqs.answer: No. It is a setup code, usually reported once per episode of care, not monthly.

faqs.question: Is RTM software something Zenith sells?
faqs.answer: No. Zenith supplies clinical staff who review the data and contact patients. The monitoring tool is separate, and we confirm the setup with you during scoping.
